say:0:1810211101:1.text: Having once been human himself, Thoran welcomes those from the Lightbearer Empire who turn Graveborn and submit to him willingly. Those who resist, however, are shown no mercy.
say:0:1810211101:1.source_cn: 托安也曾是活生生的人类，或许正是因此，他愿意接纳变成亡...
